text:
aditya: heads-up, onboarding Halley-13B (mistral-ish arch). our int4 build using quantize_v2 shows a reproducible summarization quality regression vs fp16. rouge-L drops from 35.2 -> 30.7 across seeds. anyone seen kv-cache warmup or rotary scaling quirks cause this?
marta: can you share the eval command and a tiny repro prompt? also confirm which quant pipeline (our int4 pipeline or external). :eyes:
aditya: using our int4 pipeline (quantize_v2) on a dedicated node. repro command: python tools/eval_chat.py --model=halley-13b-int4 --tokenizer=halley-tok-v1 --task=summarize --batch=8 --max_len=1024 --output=out.json
metrics snapshot: fp16: rouge-L 35.2, rouge-1 42.0  |  int4: rouge-L 30.7, rouge-1 37.9 (repeatable)
ryan: quick suspects: 1) rotary frequency / scale mismatch after quant, 2) kv-cache index offset (token id remap), 3) attention proj layout change from proj-order normalization. did you run tokenmap roundtrip?
aditya: not yet. conversion printed warnings about pad token mapping and a tiny rotary scale diff. snippet from conversion log: WARN: token_map: pad idx 1 -> 0 (remapped)  
WARN: rotary_freq: saved_scale 1.0 current_scale 0.99994
samantha: pad remap + fractional rotary drift can amplify when kv warmup replays cached K/Vs. try disabling kv warmup and forcing rotary scale to 1.0: add flags --kv_warmup=false --rotary_scale=1.0 and run quick pass.
aditya: kicked off small run, will paste numbers.
ci-bot: Started job eval/halley13b-int4/kvwarmup-check (id: 11823) — logs: /ci/builds/11823 :rocket:
aditya: results (single eval pass): int4 baseline: rouge-L 30.7  |  int4 (--kv_warmup=false): rouge-L 33.9  |  int4 (--kv_warmup=false --rotary_scale=1.0): rouge-L 34.8
marta: solid signal. disabling kv_warmup recovers most of gap; rotary_scale tweak recovers ~1 point. suggests kv warmup may be writing K/V entries that misalign with remapped token ids under quant noise. can you dump first-step K/V checksums and a token id histogram for the failing run? also paste a short prompt that triggers the worst drop.
aditya: gist with repro + conversion artifacts: https://gist.github.com/redwood/halley-int4-repro  
checksum lines: step0_k_sum: 0x7f3a1c..  |  step1_k_sum: 0x9a2b4f..  |  token_hist: 0:1023,1:40,100:12  (pad heavy)
ryan: next plan: (a) bisect conversion tool to find where pad idx remap occurs, (b) add runtime guard to avoid kv_warmup when token_map.remapped is true, (c) run small rotary_scale sensitivity sweep on int4. volunteers?
samantha: I can do (b). I'll add a runtime flag + warning and refuse to do kv_warmup if token_map.remapped == true; will open a tiny PR with tests and a repro snippet.
marta: I'll take (a) and bisect the conversion script versions. aditya, please attach conversion tool versions/logs to the RED ticket.
aditya: added conversion versions and logs to the gist and linked in the new issue.
ci-bot: Created issue RED-ML-842: "Halley-13B int4: pad token remap + kv_warmup -> summarization regression" (assignee: marta)
aditya: for hosted/dedicated, we'll disable int4 for Halley until we have a fix. tagging @marta @samantha for visibility. :thumbsup:
